issues.title: Issues and revisions
issues.intro: Record each set of sheets you give out, see what changed since, and keep site instructions, shop drawings and linked models against the issue they belong to. The history is kept in this file.
issues.f.name: To
issues.f.snapshot: Also save a copy of the model as issued
issues.f.help: A sheet that changed since it was last issued takes this revision. A sheet that did not change keeps the revision it has.
issues.nosheets: There are no sheets to issue yet.
issues.confirm.remove: Remove issue {code} from the history? Its records stay, without an issue.
issues.imported: Issue history read: {issues} new issues, {records} new records.
issues.h.name: To and by
issues.h.records.title: Records against issues
issues.h.title: Title
issues.log.help: One row for each sheet, one column for each issue. A revision in brackets was issued again unchanged. An empty box means the sheet was not in that issue.
issues.log.none: The changelog starts with the first issue.
issues.changes.title: What changed since issue {code} ({date})
issues.changes.sum: Since the issue: {changed} sheets changed, {added} new, {removed} removed, {same} the same.
issues.changes.els: Elements: {added} added, {removed} removed, {changed} changed, {same} the same.
issues.changes.noprints: No element record was kept with this issue, so only the sheets are compared.
issues.changes.removed.note: {n} removed elements are not in the model any more, so they cannot be selected.
issues.r.title: Title
issues.r.link.ph: A web address, or the name of a file kept beside this one
issues.act.marks.none: Select the markups first, and record an issue to put them against.
issues.own.note: Sheets are issued from Drawings. Those issues are listed here with everything recorded against them.
issues.r.help: A file you choose is recorded by its name, size and SHA-256 so it can be recognised later. The file itself stays where it is.
issues.err.code: Revision {code} is already used by an earlier issue.
issues.err.title: Give the record a title.
issues.err.nochanges: That issue is not in the history any more.
issues.err.import.json: That file is not an issue history.
issues.err.import.format: That file is not an issue history.
issues.err.import.newer: That issue history was made by a newer version.
issues.err.import.size: That file is too large to be an issue history.
